prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE synthetic photorealistic studio educational photograph, natural human anatomy and real textures. CACE N6: NOI + PINTAR + CAIXA + AMB + ESPONJA. Semantic focus: instrument. Age mapping is mandatory: NEN is a boy aged 7, NENA a girl aged 7, NOI a tall teenage boy aged 17, NOIA a tall teenage girl aged 17, DONA an adult woman aged 40, HOME an adult man aged 40. Show body proportions and face appropriate to the exact target age, especially recipient age.  Exact scene: NOI: L’esponja, premuda contra la caixa, hi deixa una taca ampla de pintura; no hi ha pinzell. L’eina actua sobre l’objecte; no està simplement al costat. Fons blanc sense escenari de lloc recognoscible; només base de suport imprescindible. Pure white seamless background. WIDE SHOT, camera far away: entire people or animals INCLUDING FEET, every target object and ALL furniture legs fully in frame. Scale the complete composition small to fit the CENTRAL 65 percent of the canvas; leave a WHITE BORDER at least 12 percent wide on ALL FOUR sides. Never crop lower legs or desk legs. One action in one instant, no sequence or collage. Only essential support. Friendly school material. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, brands, logos, watermark, arrows or speech bubbles, including clothing and books. Humans wear ordinary clothes. Hands/paws make clear functional contact. No identifiable room or landscape.
